title: P09.2 finite Access authentication contract correction
question: P09.2 finite Access authentication contract correction
decision: PrincipalIdentity::getAuthPassword returns string and empty string when no password hash is present, matching the installed Illuminate Authenticatable contract. PrincipalUserProvider credentials PHPDoc accepts array<array-key,mixed>, matching UserProvider; credential keys and validation remain unchanged. Validate database role/workspace UUID strings and scope strings without casts; validate cached version integers/numeric strings and lock/increment results, failing closed on malformed authority state. Preserve valid authorization predicates, successful authentication, rehash locking, migrations, release metadata and all other native public signatures. Extend P09.2 task_files before writes by exactly packages/access/CHANGELOG.md, packages/access/resources/contracts/php-api.json, docs/reference/public-api.md, tests/Golden/baseline/php-surface.json and scripts/bc/approved-deltas.json for the finite delta only; keep BC base and existing approvals unchanged; append approval only for an actually reported declared changed method if needed. Use one new non-exported Identity/Internal/LowercaseColumn expression to quote configured identifiers through the active SQL grammar while preserving lower(column)=bound-email comparison; no raw dynamic SQL or new exported API. Golden admits only that internal symbol and the declared getAuthPassword return change.
rationale: PHPStan diagnostic reports real mismatches against installed Illuminate Authenticatable and UserProvider. D120 forbids false PHPDoc/suppression. Empty hash fails credential validation; this declared no-password observable change requires decision, changelog, regressions, API/Golden/BC evidence under P09.2. Unpublished author-choice under the plan mandate; no release or owner gate action.
